title: lysimachia nummularia f. longipes
intro: Lysimachia nummularia f. longipes, commonly known as Golden Moneywort, is a type of flowering plant in the primrose family, characterized by its golden-yellow leaves and stems. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Golden Moneywort include stimulating digestion, relieving flatulence, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Golden Moneywort include iridoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
